strings.course.title: German A1: conversations
strings.unit.sein.title: Getting to know each other
strings.unit.sein.summary: Introducing yourself, the verb sein and small talk.
strings.unit.cafe.title: In the café
strings.unit.cafe.summary: Ordering with möchten and a polite goodbye.
strings.obj.sein: Introduce yourself and say how you are with the verb sein.
strings.obj.cafe: Order a drink in a café and say goodbye politely.
strings.item.q-name-typed.prompt: Introduce yourself to Anna as Tom. (heißen)
strings.item.q-name-typed.expl: You say "Ich heiße Tom." or "Ich bin Tom."
strings.item.q-gut-mcq.opt.b.why: "Guten Tag" is a greeting, not an answer to how you are.
strings.item.q-gut-mcq.prompt: Anna asks: "Wie geht es dir?" Pick the answer.
strings.item.q-gut-mcq.expl: To "Wie geht es dir?" you answer e.g. "Gut, danke."
strings.item.q-herkunft-typed.prompt: Anna asks where you come from. Say you come from Austria. (kommen)
strings.item.q-kaffee-typed.prompt: The waiter asks what you would like. Order a coffee. (möchten)
strings.item.q-kaffee-typed.expl: You say "Ich möchte einen Kaffee, bitte."
strings.item.q-kuchen-mcq.opt.b.why: "Guten Morgen" is a greeting, not an answer to an offer.
strings.item.q-kuchen-mcq.opt.c.why: "Ich heiße Kuchen" says your name is Kuchen.
strings.item.q-kuchen-mcq.prompt: The waiter offers cake. Politely decline.
strings.item.q-zahlen-mcq.opt.b.why: "Ich bin drei" makes no sense here.
strings.item.q-zahlen-mcq.opt.c.why: The waiter asked for money, not for your name.
strings.item.q-zahlen-mcq.prompt: The waiter says: "Das macht drei Euro." What do you say as you pay?
strings.item.q-zahlen-mcq.expl: As you hand over the money you say "Hier, bitte."
strings.item.rp-u-cafe-1.prompt: Say goodbye to the waiter as you leave. (informal)
strings.item.rp-u-cafe-1.expl: When you leave you say "Tschüss" or "Auf Wiedersehen".
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.title: Meeting in the language school
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.setting: Anna is a new classmate at a language school in Vienna. You are on first-name terms.
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.l3.help: Anna asks: "Wie heißt du?" Answer: "Ich heiße ...".
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.l6.help: Anna repeats slowly: "Wie geht es dir?" She wants an answer, not a greeting.
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.l7.tr: Glad to hear it! And where do you come from?
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.l8.help: Anna asks: "Woher kommst du?" Answer: "Ich komme aus ...".
strings.rp.sc.u-sein-kennenlernen.l10.help: Anna is tired. With "ich" you need the form of sein.
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.title: Ordering in the café
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.setting: A café in central Vienna. The waiter Jonas addresses you with "Sie".
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l1.tr: Good day! What would you like?
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l2.help: Jonas asks: "Was möchten Sie?" Order with "Ich möchte ...".
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l3.tr: Gladly. Would you like some cake as well?
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l5.tr: Here you are. That is three euros.
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l6.help: Jonas wants the money. As you hand it over you say "Hier, bitte."
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l7.tr: Thank you very much! See you soon!
strings.rp.sc.u-cafe-bestellen.l8.help: Jonas says goodbye. Answer with a short goodbye: "Tschüss".
strings.rp.sc.finale.title: Finale: coffee with Anna
strings.rp.sc.finale.setting: You meet Anna again in Jonas's café.
strings.rp.sc.finale.l1.tr: Hello! Nice to see you here.
strings.rp.sc.finale.l3.help: Anna asks for your name. Answer: "Ich heiße ...".
strings.rp.sc.finale.l4.tr: I am thirsty. Shall we go for a coffee?
strings.rp.sc.finale.l5.help: In the café order a coffee: "Ich möchte ...".
strings.rp.sc.finale.l7.help: Anna asks how you are. Pick an answer, not a greeting.
strings.rp.sc.finale.l9.help: With "ich" you need the form of sein.
